G'oya

To'lamagan o'quvchilar ham kerak, shuning uchun students dan LEFT JOIN qilinadi. Lekin to'lovi yo'q o'quvchida p.amount NULL bo'ladi va SUM ham NULL qaytaradi. COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) uni 0 ga aylantiradi, qarz shu songa tayanib hisoblanadi.

Yechim

SELECT s.id, s.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS paid,
       s.fee - COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS debt
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.student_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.fee

s.fee GROUP BY ga qo'shildi, aks holda PostgreSQL uni SELECT da ishlatishga ruxsat bermaydi. Namunada Jasur hech narsa to'lamagan: paid 0, debt 900 000.

Tuzoqlar

COALESCE ni faqat paid ga qo'yib, debt da unutish oson. Jasurning to'lovi 0 ko'rinadi, qarzi esa NULL, chunki 900000 - NULL ham NULL:

Noto'g'riSELECT s.id, s.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS paid,
       s.fee - SUM(p.amount) AS debt
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.student_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.fee

Oddiy JOIN bilan esa Jasur natijadan butunlay tushib qoladi.
